name: rust-cli
title_zh: 从命令契约到进程级测试的 Rust CLI 全流程
tagline_zh: 写 Rust 命令行最烦的不是 clap 怎么配，是退出码、stdin 管道。
tagline_en: The hard part of a Rust CLI isn't clap config — it's exit codes, stdin pipes, signals and daemon IPC. This locks.
desc_en: Design, implement, test, and release production Rust command-line applications, including command contracts, subcommands, configuration precedence, stdin/stdout/stderr, exit codes, file safety, daemon IPC, terminal handling, packaging, and process-level tests. Use when users ask for a Rust CLI, command parser, clap integration, Unix-style pipelines, daemon clients, PTY/TUI behavior, shell completi
why_zh: 它把 CLI 当契约而不是当脚本：配置优先级、stdout/stderr 分流、退出码语义先写死。
why_en: Treats a CLI as a contract, not a script: config precedence, stdout/stderr split and exit-code semantics are fixed before.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Rust 生态的 CLI 形态，clap 之外的解析器（如 argh、bpaf）只给思路不给代码。
limit_en: Rust CLI only; non-clap parsers (argh, bpaf) get guidance, not code. PTY/TUI needs a real pty; on Windows daemon IPC and signals diverge and you.
title_en: Full-lifecycle Rust CLI: contract to process tests
